source.point_identity: Point event locationID constructed from Transect plus Site/meter mark

population: Exact frozen source-positive consecutive transect transitions from analysis/09_quantitative_early_warning.py
source_positive_rule: An exact fixed mark is positive if Thalassia occurs in any eligible source-year visit.
target_sampling_rule: An exact fixed mark is sampled if its point-event locationID occurs in any eligible target-year visit.
metrics: number and fraction of those marks resampled in target year
number of all marks shared between years
fractions of recorded-loss and recorded-persistence transitions with >=1 source-positive mark revisited
same diagnostics on 2016 and frozen scored cohort
statistical_status: Descriptive counts only; no threshold, significance criterion, model refit, subgroup rescue or new early-warning claim
boundaries: Zero positive-mark overlap allows a sampling-footprint alternative but does not prove biological persistence.
Positive-mark overlap plus loss excludes the joint assumptions of unchanged exact-mark occupancy, perfectly comparable site placement, and perfect detection; it does not tell which assumption failed.
Nominally repeated meter-mark IDs do not guarantee identical microquadrat placement or perfect detectability.
Missing subsequent year visits never become loss labels.
Numeric overlap is not evidence of demographic extinction, stress mechanism, colonization or physiological failure.
Do not tune the mark definition, overlap threshold or year subset after results.
